agent_b_row.outcome_overview_description: Antibody GMC for 7 common pneumococcal serotypes (serotypes 4, 6B, 9V, 14, 18C, 19F, and 23F) and 6 additional pneumococcal serotypes specific to 13vPnC (Serotypes 1, 3, 5, 6A, 7F, and 19A) are presented.
agent_b_row.outcome_overview_time_frame: One month after toddler dose (12 months of age)
